title: gl2D File Format
description: A JSON-based 2D scene description format inspired by glTF. Uses a y-down coordinate system (origin top-left, positive x right, positive y down, clockwise rotation in radians). The node graph must be a forest (no cycles); a node may appear in at most one children array. Type and extension names use snake_case; property names use camelCase. Colors are CSS color strings. Custom node/resource types are allowed via vendor-prefixed extensions.

scene.description: Reference to the default scene by index (number) or uid (string)

nodes.description: Array of node definitions. The node graph must be a forest: no cycles, each node in at most one children array.

resources.description: Array of resource definitions (textures, images, videos, fonts, graphics contexts, filters, styles, etc.)

extensionsUsed.description: List of all extension names present in this file

extensionsRequired.description: List of extension names required to correctly load this file. A consumer that does not understand a required extension should refuse to load.

reference.description: A reference to a node or resource by integer index (position in array) or string uid

referenceArray.description: An array of references (integer index or string uid)

matrix2d.description: A 2D affine transform matrix as [a, b, c, d, tx, ty]

rectangle.description: A rectangle as [x, y, width, height]

extensions.description: Engine-specific extension data. Keys are vendor-prefixed extension names (e.g. pixi_, phaser_, gl2d_). Values are open objects.

asset.description: Metadata about the gl2D asset. gl2D follows semver: minor versions are additive only, major versions may break.

generator.description: Tool or library that created this file

minVersion.description: Minimum gl2D version required to render this file correctly

scene.description: A scene is a collection of root nodes. Multiple scenes can exist in one file (e.g. menu, gameplay, credits).

nodes.description: References to root nodes in the global nodes array

width.description: Design width of the scene in pixels

height.description: Design height of the scene in pixels

coreNodeProperties.description: Properties shared by all node types. If matrix is present, translation/rotation/scale are ignored. Serializers should omit fields matching default values.

uid.description: Unique identifier used for string references

children.description: References to child nodes. A node may appear in at most one children array.

translation.description: Position [x, y]. Ignored if matrix is present.

rotation.description: Rotation in radians (clockwise). Ignored if matrix is present.

scale.description: Scale [x, y]. Ignored if matrix is present.

matrix.description: 2D affine transform matrix [a, b, c, d, tx, ty]. When present, translation/rotation/scale are ignored. Mutually exclusive with TRS properties.

blendMode.description: Blend mode (W3C Compositing spec + common extras)

node.description: A node in the scene graph. Discriminated on the 'type' field. Unrecognized types should be treated as containers (children still render, specific behavior lost).

containerNode.description: Groups other nodes and applies hierarchical transforms. No additional core properties beyond shared node properties.

tilingSpriteNode.description: Repeats its texture to fill width/height. Useful for backgrounds, patterns, and infinite scrolling textures.

width.description: Width of the tiling area in pixels

height.description: Height of the tiling area in pixels

nineSliceSpriteNode.description: Scales its texture while preserving corners and edges using nine-slice scaling

width.description: Width of the nine-slice sprite in pixels

height.description: Height of the nine-slice sprite in pixels

leftWidth.description: Width of the left column in pixels

topHeight.description: Height of the top row in pixels

rightWidth.description: Width of the right column in pixels

bottomHeight.description: Height of the bottom row in pixels

textNode.description: Renders text content using a specified text style and optional web font

bitmapTextNode.description: Renders text using a pre-rendered bitmap font atlas for improved performance

htmlTextNode.description: Renders HTML/CSS content into a texture

animatedSpriteNode.description: Renders a sequence of texture frames as an animation. Frame source is specified using ONE of two mutually exclusive approaches: 'textures' (array of texture references) OR 'spritesheet' + 'animation' (named animation within a spritesheet).

textures.description: Array of texture references for loose-texture animation. Mutually exclusive with spritesheet + animation.

spritesheet.description: Reference to a spritesheet resource. Used with 'animation'. Mutually exclusive with 'textures'.

animation.description: Named animation within the spritesheet. Used with 'spritesheet'. Mutually exclusive with 'textures'.

graphicsNode.description: Renders vector graphics from a shared graphics context resource

meshNode.description: Renders custom geometry with a texture. Vertex data is stored as flat number arrays.

vertices.description: Flat array of vertex positions (pairs of x, y)

uvs.description: Flat array of UV coordinates (pairs of u, v)

particleContainerNode.description: Renders a large number of particles efficiently using a shared texture. Particle data is stored as parallel flat arrays. Does not support scene graph children.

texture.description: Reference to the shared texture resource for all particles

positions.description: Flat array of [x, y] pairs per particle. Array length must be even; particle count is length / 2.

rotations.description: One rotation value (radians) per particle. Length must equal particle count.

scales.description: Flat array of [x, y] scale pairs per particle. Length must equal particle count * 2.

tints.description: One CSS color string per particle. Length must equal particle count.

alphas.description: One opacity value (0.0-1.0) per particle. Length must equal particle count.

customNode.description: A custom node type defined via extensions. Must use a vendor-prefixed type name (e.g. 'phaser_tilemap'). Consumers that do not recognize the type should treat it as a container.

type.description: Vendor-prefixed custom node type. Must not match any core node type.

resource.description: A reusable asset: texture, image source, video source, spritesheet, graphics context, text style, web font, bitmap font, canvas gradient, canvas pattern, or filter. Custom resource types are allowed via vendor-prefixed type names.

textureSourceBaseProperties.description: Base properties shared by all texture source types (image_source, video_source, etc.)

uri.description: Path, URL, or data URI to the resource. URIs are relative to the .gl2d file location.

format.description: Texture format. Availability of compressed formats depends on platform features.

addressMode.description: Wrap mode for U, V, W simultaneously

textureResource.description: A texture resource representing a portion of a texture source. Source can point to an image_source, video_source, or spritesheet. When source is image/video, 'frame' defines the crop rectangle. When source is a spritesheet, 'frameName' identifies the sub-image.

source.description: Reference to a texture source (image_source, video_source) or spritesheet resource

frame.description: Rectangle crop from source [x, y, width, height]. Used with image/video sources.

frameName.description: Frame name within a spritesheet. Used with spritesheet sources.

imageSourceResource.description: A 2D image texture source. Extends TextureSource base properties.

videoSourceResource.description: A 2D video texture source. Extends TextureSource base properties with video-specific options.

crossorigin.description: Cross-origin attribute for the video element

spritesheetResource.description: A collection of sprites packed into a single texture atlas

uri.description: Path or URL to the spritesheet JSON file

source.description: Reference to the underlying image source resource

graphicsContextResource.description: A shared set of vector drawing commands. Multiple graphics nodes can reference the same context. The command list mirrors drawing APIs with interleaved fill/stroke style and path commands.

commands.description: Ordered list of draw commands (path commands and style commands)

graphicsCommand.description: A single graphics drawing command. Discriminated on the 'action' field.

x.description: X coordinate (used by moveTo, lineTo, bezierCurveTo, quadraticCurveTo, arc, rect, circle, ellipse, roundRect)

y.description: Y coordinate (used by moveTo, lineTo, bezierCurveTo, quadraticCurveTo, arc, rect, circle, ellipse, roundRect)

counterclockwise.description: Whether the arc is drawn counterclockwise (arc)

points.description: Flat array of point coordinates for polygon

close.description: Whether to close the polygon path

texture.description: Reference to a texture resource for textured fills (beginFill)

textStyleResource.description: Defines reusable styling for text rendering

fontFamily.description: Font family name(s) in priority order

shadow.description: Drop shadow configuration for the text

textShadow.description: Drop shadow configuration for text rendering

textWordWrap.description: Word wrapping configuration for text rendering

width.description: Maximum width in pixels before wrapping

webFontResource.description: Defines a web font for text rendering

uri.description: Path or URL to the font file

bitmapFontResource.description: Defines a pre-rendered bitmap font atlas

uri.description: Path or URL to the bitmap font file

canvasGradientResource.description: Defines linear or radial color gradients for use in fills and strokes

stops.description: Alternating [position, color] values. Positions are 0.0-1.0 numbers, colors are CSS color strings.

linear.description: Linear gradient configuration. Required when gradientType is 'linear'.

radial.description: Radial gradient configuration. Required when gradientType is 'radial'.

canvasPatternResource.description: Defines a repeating texture pattern for use in fills and strokes

transform.description: 2D transformation matrix [a, b, c, d, tx, ty] applied to the pattern

filterResource.description: Defines a visual effect that can be applied to nodes via the gl2d_filters standard extension. Filter types use the open type system; the core spec defines 'blur' and 'alpha', engines can add vendor-specific types with prefixed names.

filterType.description: Filter type identifier. Standard types: 'blur', 'alpha'. Vendor-specific types use prefixed names (e.g. 'pixi_displacement').

params.description: Filter-specific parameters. Structure depends on filterType.

customResource.description: A custom resource type defined via extensions. Must use a vendor-prefixed type name (e.g. 'spine_skeleton'). Unknown resource types are skipped by consumers.

type.description: Vendor-prefixed custom resource type. Must not match any core resource type.
